1. Heard Ms. B. Dash, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. S.S. Pradhan, learned Addl.
Government Advocate for the State.
2.

This is an application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the petitioner in connection with Jamankira P.S. Case No. 81 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 402 of 2023 pending in the Court of the learned S.D.J.M., Kuchinda under Sections 420, 506 of IPC.
3.
The petitioner had moved an application for bail before the Court of learned Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Kuchinda which was rejected on 28.08.2023.

entities.text: Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Kuchinda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The prosecution allegation in brief is that the petitioner is a contractor and he goes to Manorama Dhaba regularly for having food.

On one occasion, he had shown the informant his photographs with some politicians and police personnel and for doing so had assured to provide him A-Class contractor licence and had taken Rs.80,000/- from him in two spells.
When he did not provide the licence and the informant asked him for return of his money, the petitioner threatened him for which kept quiet.
But when the informant learnt from the newspaper that the petitioner has been arrested in another case, the informant gathered the courage to lodge FIR against him.

5. Ms. B. Dash, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the false allegation has been made against the petitioner as the informant has not been able to produce any documentary proof that the petitioner had taken money from the informant.

1 remanded in this case, on 24.08.2023 charge sheet has been filed.
As the offences are triable by the Magistrate and investigation is over, no useful purpose will be served by detaining the petitioner in custody.

She files the affidavit of Sarat Chandra Mohanty father of the petitioner stating that the petitioner has 12 criminal antecedents and he has been released on bail in all the cases and he is not involved in Jujumura P.S. Case No. 102 of 2016 and while he was arrested in Hirakud P.S. Case No.
148 of 2023 on 25.07.2023
, he has been remanded in the present case Jamankira P.S. Case No. 81 of 2023.
The said affidavit is taken on record.
6. S.S. Pradhan, learned Addl.

Government Advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail stating the petitioner has a number of criminal antecedents which are similar in nature and if he will be released on bail, he will try to tamper with the evidence and commit similar offence.

BLAPL No.
10408 of 2023 filed by the petitioner is listed today.

7. Considering the respective submissions, the nature of allegations against the petitioner, the period of his detention in custody and as the investigation has already been completed, I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail.

8. Let the petitioner- Lokanath Mohanty be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be fixed by the learned Court below in seisin over the matter, including the following conditions, after verification of the averments in the affidavit regarding the criminal antecedents:
( i) He will not commit similar offence while on bail.
(ii) After his release he will co-operate with the investigation and he will report before the Jamankira Police Station once in a week on every Sunday between 10.00 a.m. to 5.00 p.m.

(iii) He shall furnish cash security of Rs.10,000/- and the amount will be kept in fixed deposit in a Nationalized Bank.
9. Violation of any condition will entail in cancellation of bail.
10. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.

12. A copy of this order be supplied to Mr. S.S. Pradhan, learned Addl. Govt. Advocate for onward transmission to the I.I.C., Jamankira Police Station.
13.
A copy of this order along with affidavit dated 16.10.2023 filed by Sarat Chandra Mohanty be sent to the learned S.D.J.M., Kuchinda for verification.
